title: Engineering Student (m/f/d)
description:
Engineering Student (m/f/d)
We are a dynamic and innovative technology company looking for talented students and interns to join our team as Software Engineers. Gain hands-on experience in software development and contribute to real-world projects.
Your Tasks
Collaborate with our experienced software development team
Support the development of new features, enhancements, and bug fixes, ensuring high code quality and adhering to coding standards and best practices
Apply best practices to develop robust, scalable and efficient systems.
Your Profile
Currently enrolled as a student or recent graduate in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
Experienced in Rust, C++, or Nix. Interested in low-level engineering and operating systems
Apply for this position
If you would like to apply, send your CV to jobs@cyberus-technology.de.
Why join Cyberus Technology?
At Cyberus Technology, we believe great work happens when talented people feel empowered, supported, and inspired. That’s why we offer more than just a job — we offer an environment where innovation, flexibility & personal growth are part of everyday life.
An open-minded, creative, and lovely team
Drinks and fruits for free in our office in Dresden
Modern work place, desks adjustable for height
Flexible work, designed to your preferences
Home office option (partially or permanently)
A family-friendly work-life balanced environment
Time and resources for personal development
Belong to a team that lives by its values
At Cyberus Technology, our values aren’t just words — they guide how we work, how we collaborate, and how we grow. From scientific integrity to openness and wellbeing, our principles shape a culture where people thrive and meaningful innovation happens.
Partnership

We aspire to be a trusted, transparent, long-term collaborative partner to all our customers.
Responsibility

We aim to be an active, visible and constructive member of our community locally, nationally and internationally with a low and ever decreasing environmental footprint.
Integrity

We value democracy, liberty, decency, respect and human rights and we always aim to make judgements on our business engagements relative to these values.
Science

We believe in the scientific method; our decisions are driven by data, science and facts.
Openness

We believe in openness and transparency and therefore our products are available as open-source.
Wellbeing

We aim to be a family friendly, efficient and positive workplace guided by practical common sense.
Efficiency

We aim to role-model deploying lean, efficient processes, boosted by automation whenever possible.
Reliability

We aim to deliver hassle-free software products, components and configurations that "just work".
